prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1334; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the lumbar and paraspinal strain diagnosed at intake. Over the course of eleven visits, care included manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. Progress has been steady, though the course of treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this severity, reflecting a slower rate of symptom resolution and intermittent flare-ups with increased activity. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving the same region of the back. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicative charges for each service rendered. Continued home exercise and a reassessment in four weeks are recommended, with return precautions reviewed.
